page.layout: One page of running text, two-line-spaced body, with three marginal notes in the left margin: "Iohan.20." beside the second paragraph, "Mar.5." beside the same paragraph, and a three-line italic note "Argumentum de Sacramentorum analogia." beside the third paragraph. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword "quo" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: gnoris loco obtigisse corporale hanc mäducatio-nem asseris:&tamē ad incredulos eam protendi ais:credetes uerò illos patres ea priuas, nihilomi nus postea ipsis nihil esse denegatum defendis.

Cum nactus fueris ocium Tilemāne(nam te ociū ferre iniquisimè scio) inuolucra ista nobis euol-uere:profiteor enim me Oedipum nō esse. Simul e-tiā explica,quàm sit eximiū beneficiū, oculis con Iohan.20.spexisse Christū in terris uiuentē:cum Christus di serte beatos pronunciet eos, qui nō uiderūt, crediderūt tamen.Nam parū admodū mihi tribuere uidetur carnis cōspectui:quo non tatū pleriq;, nō sunt meliores facti, sed etiā deteriores. ut nō ad-Mar.5.modū morabatur sui cōtactū, eorū qui ipsum uehementer premebat: mulieris uerò quæ fimbriæ extremitatem obiter cōtrectarat,miratur,laudat, prædicat fidē.Nā ex his & huius generis alijs pleriq;, si attentè cogitetur, cōsici mihi uidetur: externa ista omnia,si seorsim à fide ac spiritali motu cōsideretur(ut nūc cōsideramus,cum eā mandu-catione ut nouo Testamēto,tuo iudicio,peculia-rem cogitamus)non ita magni esse momenti. An uerò eā pignus & obsignatio dici uel debeat uel possit,paulo post expendemus,

Argumen-tum de Sa-cramētorū analogia.¶Ifti rationi(ut uocas)altera annectis, de natu ra & proprietate sacramentorū:ex qua, utra uero propior sit sentetia, dijudicari facile posse putas. Hoc ego λειτουργιον[?] mihi abs te oblatū esse,uehemē ter gaudeo: & arripio nō secus atq; gladiū utrinque scindetem (ut cum sacris literis loquar) quo ad te cofodiendū nullus aptior eligi potuit. Hūc què mihi aperuisti campū exultans ingredior: ex

page.notes: Greek word at the end of the Hoc ego sentence is read as λειτουργιον with doubt; the letters on the scan are blurred. "què" after "Hūc" is doubtful. "pleriq;, si" and "sentetia" follow the scan but are hard to read. Running head printed in small capitals with a Q for V. Page number printed at top left. Catchword "quo" printed at lower right, so the text ends on "ex".
